hero.headline: Coffee Roasted the Slow Way
hero.subheadline: Twenty-pound batches, nine farm partners we know by name, and a roast date printed on every bag. This is coffee with a paper trail.
bullets: Roasted to order, shipped within 48 hours
Free pickup at all three cafes

features.headline: From Green Bean to Brew Bar
features.subheadline: Four programs, one obsession: coffee that tastes like where it grew.

items.title: Single Origins
items.desc: Rotating lots from farms we visit and buy from year after year. Each bag lists the producer, the elevation, and the week it was roasted.
details: Ethiopia, Colombia, Guatemala, and Sumatra on the current menu
Whole bean or ground for your brewer

items.title: Signature Blends
items.desc: Three house blends built for everyday brewing: Ember for dark, Oak for medium, and Morning Porch for breakfast. Consistent profiles, batch after batch.
details: Available in 12 oz and 5 lb bags

items.title: Cold Brew & Cans
items.desc: Slow-steeped for 18 hours in small tanks, then kegged or canned right at the roastery. Stocked in our cafes and a handful of local grocers.

items.title: Wholesale & Training
items.desc: We supply cafes and restaurants within a day's drive, and we train every account's bar staff ourselves, dialing in grinders, water, and milk.
details: Loaner equipment while yours is serviced
